Career Hub
text: Leadership is at the heart of every great school. Across the UK, strong leaders shape school culture, inspire staff, and make a huge difference to the lives of children and young people.
Schools don’t run on teachers alone. Behind every great lesson, every calm corridor, and every supported student is a team of dedicated school support staff.
Teaching is more than a job: it’s a chance to shape lives, spark curiosity, and help young people discover who they are and what they can become.
Explore our free and on‑demand education and employment webinars, created to support teachers, school leaders and education professionals at every stage of their career.

sections.label: Essentials
text: Why Should You Become a Teacher?

Deciding to become a teacher is a significant step, and it is one that comes with purpose, challenge and enormous reward. How can I become a teacher?

There are several routes into teaching in England and Wales. To teach in maintained schools, you’ll need to complete Initial Teacher Training (ITT) leading to Qualified Teacher Status (QTS).
